title: Universal openness of finitely presented locally quasi-finite morphisms descends through affine inverse limits
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Étale localization and finite quasi-compact covers reduce the problem to a finite finitely presented algebra. The proof encodes universal openness by the image of a universal linear combination of module generators, then descends both that open image and its surjective parametrization to a finite stage.
